description: Check whether one US ZIP code gets in-home appliance repair. Covered: Tennessee and Louisiana, except a few ZIPs we don't go to (Auburntown 37016, Castalian Springs 37031, Christiana 37037, Eagleville 37060, Shelbyville 37160). Use it before book_repair, or when the person asks "do you come to me?". Returns covered (true/false), the state and market when covered, and a plain message to pass on; when not covered it returns alternative "video_diagnostic" (the $50 video Quick Check, anywhere in the US, with the exact part shipped to their door if they want to fix it themselves). Read-only: no side effects, the same ZIP always gives the same answer. An invalid ZIP returns an error field instead. The $50 video Quick Check (anywhere in the US, credited toward the repair) is started by the person at https://tnapplianceexchange.net/quick-check-intake.html because it takes their payment there; no tool books it.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the home where the appliance is (ZIP+4 is fine; extra characters are ignored).

name: check_service_area

covered.description: true when we make house calls to this ZIP

error.description: Present only when the call could not be completed; says what to fix or who to call.

message.description: A plain-English answer you can pass to the person as is.

not_serviced.description: true for the few TN ZIPs we do not go to

title: Check service area
